about: Every provider and keyed service ramen-agents knows, with the key file it reads and how you add the key. status: chain = in the default model chain; opt-in = used only if you add it yourself; removed = no longer used. free and card say what the provider's own page says. scripts/test_providers_list.py checks this list against setup-check.py, add-key.sh and web-bots.toml.

providers.name: zai
providers.card: The flash model is list-priced $0; its page does not state whether a card is needed.

providers.name: gemini
providers.card: Free; its page does not state whether a card is needed. It takes no lead data until you say yes in sh scripts/add-key.sh gemini, with Google's terms in front of you.

providers.name: groq
providers.card: Free; its page does not state whether a card is needed.

providers.name: openrouter
providers.card: Only its :free models are used; its page does not state whether a card is needed.

providers.name: mistral
providers.card: Its API needs billing activation and pay-as-you-go. Out of the default chain since 2026-11-21.

providers.name: ollama-cloud
providers.card: Pay per token. Out of the default chain since 2026-11-21.

providers.name: speka
providers.card: A $1 lifetime credit, then pay per token. Out of the default chain since 2026-11-21.

providers.name: quickemailverification
providers.card: Optional: Lead Gen checks an email before listing it.

providers.name: langsearch
providers.card: Free plan; its page does not state whether a card is needed. The first backup when the local search fails or finds nothing.

providers.name: tavily
providers.card: 1,000 credits a month; its pricing page: "No credit card required". The CEO only, for special searches.

providers.name: parallel
providers.card: $5 of free credit a month with a card on file (its page), then it bills per use. Out of the default search path since 2026-11-21.

providers.name: notion
providers.card: No longer used: the boards are on your dashboard. common-data/keys/notion.key can be deleted.
